page_title: LEN 0-2 PSG | Lens v PSG 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Great chance! Ayanda Sishuba (Lens) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the left post.
90+2' Bradley Barcola (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 0 - 2 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Ousmane Dembele finds Kylian Mbappe (PSG) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
89' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
88' A cross by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.

88' Ayanda Sishuba (Lens) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
86' The substitution has been made. Ayanda Sishuba (Lens) has replaced Neil El Aynaoui.
84' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Brice Samba stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
83' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
83' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
80' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
78' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
77' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) launches a cross from the corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma is alert to thwart the effort.
77' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
76' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Lens can continue in their attacking effort.
74' Substitution. Wesley Said (Lens) on for Elye Wahi.
74' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Adrien Thomasson (Lens) replaces David Costa.
74' Substitution. Angelo Fulgini (Lens) in, Andy Diouf out.
72' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just over the bar.
70' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
67' Vitinha (PSG) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
66' None of the PSG players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
65' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Soler departs the field of play to be replaced by Fabian Ruiz (PSG).
62' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
60' A shot from the edge of the box by Vitinha (PSG) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
59' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens). Free kick. PSG will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
58' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
57' Vitinha (PSG) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
55' Gianluigi Donnarumma stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom left corner.
54' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Marquinhos (PSG), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
53' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for PSG.
53' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Marquinhos (PSG).
52' Carlos Soler (PSG) receives a yellow card for infringement.
51' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
49' The ball is out of play. PSG will have a throw-in.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Faitout Maouassa leaves the pitch and Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) comes on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Jerome Brisard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Jonathan Gradit (Lens). He’s got to go!

45+2' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Jonathan Gradit (Lens), but referee Jerome Brisard must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
45+2' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
45+1' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
43' Carlos Soler (PSG) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
42' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Kylian Mbappe (PSG) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Brice Samba easily catches the ball.
41' PSG take a short corner kick.
41' Carlos Soler (PSG) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper. PSG have a corner.
39' The ball is cleared after Florian Sotoca (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
38' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
38' Bradley Barcola (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
34' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
33' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
30' 0 - 1 Bradley Barcola (PSG) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
28' Faitout Maouassa (Lens) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
28' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned David Costa (Lens), but the defence gets it clear.
27' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
23' Jerome Brisard blows the whistle, Faitout Maouassa (Lens) is penalised for a foul. PSG are awarded a free kick.
23' Kevin Danso (Lens) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
22' Faitout Maouassa (Lens) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

22' Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a brilliant save! Elye Wahi (Lens) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the top left corner but is saved by the keeper! Lens force a corner. They send men into the box.
21' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
20' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
18' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
17' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
15' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
14' Bradley Barcola (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
13' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
12' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Jonathan Gradit (Lens) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to PSG.
11' Florian Sotoca (Lens) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
10' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
9' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' David Costa (Lens) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
6' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot low into the middle of the target, but Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off a save.
6' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
6' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle after Danilo Pereira (PSG) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Lens are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
5' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Brice Samba makes a comfortable save.
5' Elye Wahi (Lens) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Kylian Mbappe (PSG) offside.
2' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
PSG will kick-off.
Jerome Brisard will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
